responsibility: Implements the -Wrestrict pass and shared overlap/bounds checking for built-in string and raw memory functions. It models destination and source references with pointer-query-derived base objects, offsets, and size ranges, checks for out-of-bounds accesses and overlapping copies that violate restrict semantics, and emits diagnostics for calls such as memcpy/strcpy-family built-ins when arguments alias unsafely or exceed object bounds.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the dedicated -Wrestrict pass and overlap/bounds analysis of built-in memory and string calls; unlike gcc/gimple-ssa-warn-restrict.h, it defines pass_wrestrict, the builtin_memref/builtin_access analysis machinery, and the exported checking routines' bodies.
